newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline surfs transatlantic arbitrage wave.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline surfs transatlantic arbitrage wave.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices retraced late Friday losses on Monday, led higher by strong NYMEX unleaded which put on over two cents a gallon, traders said.
The NYMEX gains, driven by strong heating oil, continued to fuel interest for product to take transatlantic and boosted both barge and cargo premiums.

The main buying interest was for barges with several trading houses thought to be looking to put together cargoes in the light of scarce cargo offers. Traders said that cargo offers were scarce because some refiners have been sending product, usually sold into the European market, transatlantic.
